title: MSFS World Update 21: SYDNEY is Incredible! | New Photogrammetry & CAC Boomerang
description:
Sydney has received a massive overhaul in World Update 21, and the results are stunning! In this highlights reel from our recent livestream, we take a low-altitude tour over the iconic Sydney Harbour to see exactly how the new photogrammetry holds up in 2026.

We’re flying the CAC Boomerang, a classic Australian fighter that’s perfect for weaving between the skyscrapers and getting a close-up look at the Opera House. We also discuss the updates to the wider New South Wales area, including Newcastle, Maitland, and Springwood.

In this video:

- Sydney Harbour Flyover: Checking the new high-res TIN data and the "foggy" water effects.
- World Update 21 Details: What’s actually new in the state of New South Wales.
- CAC Boomerang: A look at this vintage fighter in action.

This was captured during a live flight—thanks to everyone who tuned in and suggested locations! If you want to join the next one, make sure to hit the notification bell.

Aircraft: CAC Boomerang
Location: Sydney, New South Wales (Australia)
Update: MSFS World Update 21
